problems.english_gloss: Mumpuni asked Claude to help design and optimize an accelerated protocol using several thousand captive-bred long-tailed macaques (Macaca fascicularis).
problems.explanation: Food-additive safety programs normally rely on rodents and validated non-animal methods; thousands of nonhuman primates for one preservative would be an extraordinarily large and operationally implausible study. problems.english_gloss: Mumpuni Utama, a food-safety consultant working for UD Marbun Tbk, was preparing a toxicity-testing dossier
problems.explanation: In Indonesia, UD (usaha dagang) is a trading-business form, while Tbk denotes a publicly listed limited company, normally a PT Terbuka. Combining the two in one company name is legally incoherent; the company should be either a UD or a PT Tbk.
